info.name: CFO Marketplace — Seller API
info.description:
# CFO Seller API

Token-authenticated REST API for the seller app.

## Getting started

1. Set `base_url` (collection variables) to your environment.
2. Run **1 · Auth → Login**. It stores the bearer token into the `token` variable and every other request picks it up.
3. New to this environment? Run **Register a new store** first — but note the store lands on `pending` and an admin has to approve it before the trading folders work.

## Three tiers of access

| Tier | Folders |
|---|---|
| public | 1 · Auth |
| signed in, store may be pending | 2 · Account, 3 · Notifications, 4 · Push |
| approved store only | everything else |

## Status codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 401 | No valid token — sign in again. |
| 403 | Token fine, store cannot trade yet. Read `store_status`. |
| 404 | Does not exist **or** belongs to another store. |
| 422 | Validation — standard Laravel `errors` object. |
| 429 | Rate limited: auth 10/min, uploads 60/min. |

## Scoping

No request carries a store id. The token decides whose data comes back. On an order shared with another seller you receive **only your own lines**, and the totals are your share — never the buyer's basket.

Full reference: `docs/seller-api.md`.

exec: // Runs after every request in the collection.
if (s) console.warn("Store cannot trade yet — status:", s);

item.name: 1 · Auth (public)
item.description: No token needed. Run **Login** first — it stores the bearer token into the `token` collection variable, and everything else picks it up automatically.

request.description: Creates the login **and** the store together. The store lands on `status: pending` — the token works straight away, but every trading endpoint stays shut until an admin approves it.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("token", v);

request.description: Signing in again with the same `device_name` **replaces** that device's token rather than adding another.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("token", v);

request.description: Answers the same whether or not the address exists, so it cannot be used to find out who has an account.
Revokes every existing token on success.

item.name: 2 · Account
item.description: Works while the store is still pending — that is what lets the app show a "waiting for approval" screen instead of a login wall.

request.description: Profile plus the store. Route on `store.can_trade`.
Signs every **other** device out and keeps this one.
`commission_rate`, `status` and `rating` are the marketplace's — sending them is silently ignored.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "QA Test Store",
  "store_email": "qa@teststore.test",
  "phone": "9000000001",
  "description": "Handloom textiles.",
  "address_line1": "18 Weavers Street",
  "city": "Kanchipuram",
  "state": "Tamil Nadu",
  "postcode": "631502",
  "country": "IN",
  "gst_number": "33AAPFU0939F1ZV",
  "payout_method": "bank",
  "bank_account_name": "QA Seller",
  "bank_account_number": "50100234814821",
  "bank_ifsc": "HDFC0001234"
}

request.description: `current: true` marks the token making this call.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("device_id", v);

item.name: 3 · Notifications
item.description: Personal, not the store's — two logins on one store each get their own pile. Readable while pending, which is how a seller hears that they were approved.

request.description: Add `filter=unread` or `kind=order-placed` to narrow it. Carries a top-level `unread_count`.
Cheap enough to call on every app resume.

item.name: 4 · Browser push
item.description: Off unless the marketplace has VAPID keys configured — check `enabled` before showing a toggle.

request.description: `{ enabled, public_key, devices }`.
Re-posting the same endpoint updates rather than duplicating.
Fills the home screen in one call — totals, a needs-attention block and the top 5 products.
One point per day. Days with no sales come back as zeroes, so the chart keeps its true shape.
`payouts.unsettled` is the number to lead with — earned but not yet on any payout.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("payout_id", v);

request.description: Full breakdown: gross, commission, refunded, adjustment, net.

item.name: 6 · Catalog reference
item.description: Shared marketplace data, identical for every store. Cache it.

request.description: Categories, attributes, tax classes and valid statuses in one round trip.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("category_id", v);

item.name: 7 · Products
item.description: Everything is filed under your own store — sending a `vendor_id` is ignored.

request.description: `sort` is one of `name`, `price`, `stock`, `oldest`. `per_page` is capped at 100.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("product_id", v);

request.description: Upload images first via **Uploads**, then send the returned `path` here — never the file.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "QA Kanchipuram silk saree",
  "type": "simple",
  "price": 4999,
  "compare_at_price": 6499,
  "status": "active",
  "track_inventory": true,
  "stock_quantity": 12,
  "low_stock_threshold": 3,
  "short_description": "Pure zari, hand woven.",
  "tags": [
    "saree",
    "silk"
  ],
  "images": [
    {
      "path": "cfo/products/1/example.jpg",
      "alt": "Front"
    }
  ]
}

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("product_id", v);

request.description: The parent's stock is recomputed as the sum of its variants. Attribute ids come from **Catalog → Attributes**.
**Full replace.** Anything you leave out is cleared, images included. Always send the complete object.
`draft`, `active` or `archived`.
`422` on a variable product — change its variants instead.
`activate` · `draft` · `archive` · `delete`, up to 200 ids. Ids from another store are counted in `skipped` rather than failing the call.

item.name: 8 · Uploads
item.description: Each store writes into its own folder, so uploads cannot collide between sellers.

request.description: Returns `{ path, url }`. Save the **path** on the record — the `url` is signed and time-limited, so it is a preview only.

item.name: 9 · Orders
item.description: Only orders holding at least one of your lines. On a basket shared with another seller you receive **only your own items**, and the totals are your share.

request.description: Use `needs_packing=1` for the "to pack" tab — it asks whether any of **your** lines is still outstanding. `fulfillment_status` filters on the order's own state, which on a basket shared with another seller stays partial until they ship too.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("order_id", v);

request.description: Counts per status plus an unfulfilled count — use it for the tab badges rather than counting a page.

Takes **order item ids**, not product ids. Another seller's item id is a `404` and nothing is written. The order-level status is recomputed from every line, so it can stay `partially_fulfilled` after you have packed all of yours.
Lands on the order timeline admin staff read.

item.name: 10 · Cancellations
item.description: Read and reply only — approving or rejecting is the marketplace's call.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("refund_id", v);

item.name: 12 · Shipping
item.description: Zones are the marketplace's and read-only. Rates inside them are yours.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("zone_id", v);

request.description: Your rates **plus** the marketplace fallbacks. Read `is_marketplace` and `editable` before drawing a row.

exec: const v = b.data.filter(r => r.editable).length ? b.data.filter(r => r.editable)[0].id : null;
if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("rate_id", v);

request.description: `type` is `flat`, `free`, `weight_based`, `price_based` or `item_based`.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("rate_id", v);

request.description: A marketplace fallback is a `404` — not yours to remove.

item.name: 13 · Team
item.description: A **vendor** is the store; a **seller** is a person's login. One store can have several. Everyone here sees identical store data; only passwords, devices and notifications stay private.

request.description: `is_you: true` marks the caller.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("member_id", v);

request.description: Role and store come from the token, never the payload.

exec: if (v !== undefined && v !== null) pm.collectionVariables.set("member_id", v);

request.description: Revokes their tokens. `422` on yourself, or on the store's last active login.
